name: Barcodes & QR
description: Scan barcodes locally and create QR or barcode files in your Workspace.
abilities: Decode uploaded or Workspace images locally
Create QR, Code128 and EAN13 SVG files
Reuse food lookup for requested product identification
permissions: Owner-only file access; decoded text never grants authority
Creation follows existing Workspace write permissions; delivery is a separate action

changes.notes: Official deferred tools, on by default. Load only when needed; turn off in the Store.
